G3000.def: to minister (to God), i.e. render religious homage

G3004.def: properly, to "lay" forth, i.e. (figuratively) relate (in words (usually of systematic or set discourse; whereas G2036 (ἔπω) and G5346 (φημί) generally refer to an individual expression or speech respectively; while G4483 (ῥέω) is properly to break silence merely, and G2980 (λαλέω) means an extended or random harangue)); by implication, to mean
G3004.kjv: ask, bid, boast, call, describe, give out, name, put forth, say(-ing, on), shew, speak, tell, utter

G3007.def: to leave, i.e. (intransitively or passively) to fail or be absent

G3008.def: to be a public servant, i.e. (by analogy) to perform religious or charitable functions (worship, obey, relieve)

G3011.derivation: from a derivative of G2992 (λαός) and G2041 (ἔργον);
G3011.def: a public servant, i.e. a functionary in the Temple or Gospel, or (genitive case) a worshipper (of God) or benefactor (of man)

G3016.derivation: neuter of a derivative of the same as G3013 (λεπίς);
G3016.def: something scaled (light), i.e. a small coin

G3017.def: Levi, the name of three Israelites

G3019.def: a Levite, i.e. descendant of Levi

G3020.def: Levitic, i.e. relating to the Levites

G3030.def: the incense-tree, i.e. (by implication) incense itself

G3031.def: frankincense, i.e. (by extension) a censer for burning it

G3036.derivation: from a compound of G3037 (λίθος) and G906 (βάλλω);

G3038.derivation: from G3037 (λίθος) and a derivative of G4766 (στρώννυμι);
G3038.def: stone-strewed, i.e. a tessellated mosaic on which the Roman tribunal was placed

G3039.derivation: from , the equivalent of (a winnowing fan or basket);
G3039.def: to winnow, i.e. (by analogy), to triturate

G3041.derivation: probably from G3040 (λιμήν) (through the idea of nearness of shore);

G3042.derivation: probably from G3007 (λείπω) (through the idea of destitution);

G3047.def: the south(- west) wind (as bringing rain, i.e. (by extension) the south quarter)

G3049.def: to take an inventory, i.e. estimate (literally or figuratively)
G3049.kjv: conclude, (ac-)count (of), + despise, esteem, impute, lay, number, reason, reckon, suppose, think (on)

G3054.derivation: from a compound of G3056 (λόγος) and G3164 (μάχομαι);

G3056.def: something said (including the thought); by implication, a topic (subject of discourse), also reasoning (the mental faculty) or motive; by extension, a computation; specially, (with the article in John) the Divine Expression (i.e. Christ)
G3056.kjv: account, cause, communication, X concerning, doctrine, fame, X have to do, intent, matter, mouth, preaching, question, reason, + reckon, remove, say(-ing), shew, X speaker, speech, talk, thing, + none of these things move me, tidings, treatise, utterance, word, work

G3061.def: a plague (literally, the disease, or figuratively, a pest)

G3062.derivation: masculine plural of a derivative of G3007 (λείπω);
G3062.kjv: other, which remain, remnant, residue, rest

G3063.derivation: neuter singular of the same as G3062 (λοιποί);
G3063.kjv: besides, finally, furthermore, (from) henceforth, moreover, now, + it remaineth, then

G3064.derivation: genitive case singular of the same as G3062 (λοιποί);

G3068.def: to bathe (the whole person; whereas G3538 (νίπτω) means to wet a part only, and G4150 (πλύνω) to wash, cleanse garments exclusively)

G3069.def: Lydda (i.e. Lod), a place in Palestine

G3070.derivation: properly, feminine of Ludios (of foreign origin) (a Lydian, in Asia Minor);

G3071.def: Lycaonia, a region of Asia Minor

G3072.derivation: adverb from a derivative of G3071 (Λυκαονία);
G3072.def: Lycaonistically, i.e. in the language of the Lycaonians

G3073.def: Lycia, a province of Asia Minor

G3074.derivation: perhaps akin to the base of G3022 (λευκός) (from the whitish hair);

G3075.derivation: middle voice from a probably derivative of G3089 (λύω) (meaning filth);

G3076.def: to distress; reflexively or passively, to be sad
G3076.kjv: cause grief, grieve, be in heaviness, (be) sorrow(-ful), be (make) sorry

G3078.def: grief-dispelling; Lysanias, a governor of Abilene

G3081.derivation: third person singular present indicative active of a derivative of a compound of G3080 (λύσις) and G5056 (τέλος);
G3081.def: impersonally, it answers the purpose, i.e. is advantageous

G3082.def: Lystra, a place in Asia Minor

G3083.def: something to loosen with, i.e. a redemption price (figuratively, atonement)

G3088.def: a portable lamp or other illuminator (literally or figuratively)

G3089.kjv: break (up), destroy, dissolve, (un-)loose, melt, put off

G3093.def: the tower; Magdala (i.e. Migdala), a place in Palestine

G3094.derivation: feminine of a derivative of G3093 (Μαγδαλά);
G3094.def: a female Magdalene, i.e. inhabitant of Magdala

G3097.def: a Magian, i.e. Oriental scientist; by implication, a magician

G3098.def: Magog, a foreign nation, i.e. (figuratively) an Antichristian party

G3099.def: Madian (i.e. Midian), a region of Arabia
